Reason: The ultrasound images demonstrate a fetal lung mass with multiple large, macroscopic cysts (indicated by the arrow), which is the characteristic appearance of CCAM Type I; Type II typically presents with smaller, uniform cysts, and Type III appears as a solid, echogenic mass. Although the provided images are ultrasounds rather than chest X-rays, the cyst morphology strongly supports Type I among the given choices.
